chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two friends, a boy and a girl, who really loved hockey. Every day they would go out to the park to play with their hockey kit. They would have a lot of fun balancing the hockey stick on their hands and playing games together.

One day, the park was really busy and they realised that there wasn't enough space for both teams. After thinking it over, they decided to play a fair game. So they each went to the other side of the park, taking turns to balance the hockey stick.

They had so much fun balancing the hockey stick that they lost track of time. When the sun started to set and the park began to empty out, the boy and girl said goodbye and promised to come back and play again soon.
Another day, the two friends would balance the hockey stick together, playing fair and having loads of fun.

chapters.title: Once there was a tall clumsy…
p: Once there was a tall clumsy girl who loved to run. Everywhere she went, a shadow followed her. When she ran, it ran with her.

One day, the girl decided to give her shadow a gift. She looked everywhere, but could not find the perfect present. Finally, she spotted a shiny butterfly. She reached out, grabbed it gently and gave it to her shadow.
The shadow smiled and thanked her. Then it flew away with the butterfly, never to be seen again.
The girl smiled. Giving away the butterfly made her happy. She had made her shadow happy too.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a bird. The bird was very happy and loved to fly high in the sky. Every day the bird would fly around looking for dinner.
One day the bird found something very bad. It was a dark cloud and it was chasing him. The bird flew and flew as fast as he could but the dark cloud kept getting closer.
The bird kept flying until he saw a very bright light. It was so bright that it made the dark cloud go away.

The bright light was coming from a little house in the forest. The bird flew down to say hello, and the people inside welcomed him in. They gave the bird some tasty dinner, and the bird was so happy that he sang a song of thanks.
The bird stayed at the little house for the rest of the day. He was so happy that he had found a safe place and a delicious dinner. He knew he wouldn't have to worry about the bad cloud ever again.

chapters.title: One morning there was a white…
p: One morning, there was a white storm. The sky was cloudy, and it looked like it would be raining soon. The wind blew the trees until they were swaying.
The little girl who saw the storm looked out her window. She had never seen a storm like this before, and she was very curious. She wanted to go outside and play in it.
The girl asked her mom if she could go outside, but her mom told her "no." She said it wasn't safe to play in the storm. Instead, she let the girl watch it from the window.
The little girl watched the storm for a long time, until it finally stopped. The clouds cleared and the sun started to shine. The girl smiled, happy that she got to see the storm.

chapters.title: Once there was a little bird…
p: Once there was a little bird that lived in the woods. Everyday in the spring, the bird would flutter and play in the woods. One day when the bird was playing, something disturbed it. It was a dull sound. The bird looked around but could not find what was causing the noise. All around her, the birds sang and the flowers bloomed, but the dull sound kept going and going. Suddenly, a big, scary creature appeared! It was a bear. The poor bird was so frightened! But she quickly flew away and the bear roared before going back to his cave. From that day on, the little bird was extra careful in the spring, to make sure she was never disturbed again.

chapters.title: One day Tom saw a shiny…
p: One day, Tom saw a shiny car and wanted to make his own car shine. He asked his mom for help. His mom got out a cloth and some special polish. She started to polish the car. Tom watched as the car began to sparkle in the sun.
Next, Tom wanted to help his mom. He picked up the cloth and started to polish too. His mom smiled and said, "You're doing a great job, Tom!"
When they finished polishing, Tom noticed a scratch on the car. His mom took out a bandage and put it on the scratch. She said, "The bandage will make the car more flexible."
Tom felt proud of his shiny car. He ran to show it to his dad. Together they admired the polishing job they had done.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a tiny little penny. She was small and independent. Every day she enjoyed rolling on the ground and playing with the sunbeams.

One day, the sky got really dark and it started to rain. Drops of water tapped all around the penny. She hurried and rolled as quickly as she could but the rain was too strong. Soon she was very wet, and cold.
The penny lay in the grass, sad and damp. Suddenly a friendly breeze began to blow and the rain started to stop. Slowly, the penny began to dry. She felt warm and happy again.
The penny smiled. She was thankful to the warm breeze for helping her dry. She curled up and rolled down the hill, happy and independent. The sun beamed and the penny enjoyed the rest of her day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a rabbit named Jack. He loved to eat all kinds of healthy food. Early one morning, Jack hopped into the meadow to look for something delicious to eat. When he arrived, he saw a big patch of juicy carrots. Jack was so excited that he started to munch on them right away!

Jack was so busy eating that he didn't realize he was in the shade of the big oak tree. The shade felt so nice and cool, so Jack decided to have a nap. He was feeling warm from all the eating, but the shade made him feel much better.
After his nap, Jack thanked the tree for providing such a nice and healthy place to rest. Then he hopped off into the meadow again, in search of more delicious foods!

chapters.title: The train was impressive It was…
p: The train was impressive. It was big and shiny. Jenna looked out the window and gasped with delight. The scenery flew past as the train sped down the track.
Jenna's mom leaned over and asked, "Do you want to know a secret?" Jenna's eyes lit up and she nodded. Mom continued, "I can lift the train!" Jenna's jaw dropped. She said, "Really?"

Mom smiled and said, “Yes, I can lift the train up with my hands!” Jenna thought it was so cool. “Can you teach me how to do it?” she asked eagerly. Mom nodded and said, “Maybe one day when you get bigger, I'll show you!”
Jenna couldn't wait. She kept smiling as the train rolled on, admiring the impressive sight outside her window.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a boy called Jack. He was only 3 years old but he wanted to find something exciting.
One day, Jack looked around the house. He wanted to find something fun. Suddenly, Jack saw something shiny. He looked closer and it was a trumpet!
Jack picked it up and he put it to his lips. He blew as hard as he could and then, a big, loud noise came from the trumpet.
He loved it! He took it with him everywhere he went. He also loved to try new things, so he decided to make his trumpet even more exciting.
He added many different spices, such as chilli and pepper, to make his trumpet spicy. When he blew the trumpet, it made a very spicy sound and it was so delicious, he couldn't stop smiling.
Jack was so excited that he had found such a fun thing, and he enjoyed playing with his spicy trumpet every day!

chapters.title: Once there was a young bull…
p: Once there was a young bull. He was alone in the field but he didn't mind. He just liked to lean against the big tree. From there he could look out and see the whole world.

One day, two kids came to the field. They were only three years old, just like the bull! One of the kids looked at the young bull and asked the other, "What is that?". The other kid said, "It's a bull, and it's leaning against that big tree".

The three kids were so excited! They came closer and closer to the young bull and he didn't move away. The kids patted and hugged the young bull. He was so happy! The kids stayed there for a long time, laughing and playing with the young bull.
When it became dark, the kids said goodbye to the young bull. He waved at them and went back to leaning against the big tree. He was happy and contented.

chapters.title: There was a package on the…
p: There was a package on the table. It was weird and shiny. The little girl wanted to grab it. She wanted to know what was inside. She reached for it, but it was too high for her to reach.
The girl was sad. She stood on her tippy-toes but she still couldn't stretch far enough. Then she had an idea. She grabbed a chair and used it to help her reach the package.
She was so excited when her fingers touched the package. She cradled it in her hands and pulled it close to her chest.

She was also very curious. She carefully lifted the lid and peeked inside. It was full of candy! The girl's eyes lit up with excitement. She quickly snatched one and popped it in her mouth and enjoyed it.
She felt so happy. She couldn't wait to share her sweet surprise with all her friends.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a girl named Lola. Lola was three years old and liked to share her toys with her friends. One day, Lola was playing her favourite game, but when her friend Sarah arrived, something weird happened.
Sarah was surprised to see that Lola was not sharing the game with her like she always did. This was very strange! Lola smiled and said, "I have a surprise! I am going to share it with you!"
Lola gave Sarah a shock. She had something special up her sleeve, and it was a surprise. Sarah was thrilled! She said, "It's so weird! Is it really a surprise?"
Lola smiled and said, "Yes! Let's share it together." Lola and Sarah opened the box and saw something wonderful inside! It was a beautiful, sparkly toy.
Both girls were overjoyed and shared the toy together. They laughed and hugged each other, celebrating their amazing discovery. From then on, Lola and Sarah shared many more surprises!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved sweets and pastries. One day, she went to the bakery with her mom. She saw a yummy pastry and asked her mom if she could have it. Her mom said yes and bought it for her.

Lily took a big bite of the pastry, but it tasted bad. She made a face and said, "Mommy, this pastry tastes bad. Can I have a different one?" Her mom said, "Of course, let's go pick out a different pastry."

Lily picked out a chocolate pastry and it tasted much better. She smiled and said, "This pastry is yummy! Thank you, mommy." Her mom replied, "You're welcome, Lily. I'm glad you like it." And they lived happily ever after, enjoying delicious pastries together.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily wanted to go to the park but her mom was too busy to take her. Lily felt sad because she really wanted to go.
Suddenly, a bus stopped in front of her house. A nice bus driver asked her if she wanted to go for a ride. Lily was so happy and said yes.

When they arrived at the park, Lily saw a boy who had a big, disgusting ice cream cone. She really wanted one too but she didn't have any money. The boy saw that she was sad and said, "I can share my ice cream with you, but you have to pay me."

Lily didn't know what to do. She didn't have any money. The bus driver saw what was happening and said, "Don't worry, Lily. I will pay for the ice cream." Lily was so happy and thanked the bus driver. She had a wonderful day at the park and made a new friend.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a kind and generous grandma. She loved to bake cookies and share them with her friends. One day, she made a big batch of cookies and put them in a jar. She said to her granddaughter, "Would you like to help me mail these cookies to our friends?"

The granddaughter was excited to help her grandma. They went to the post office and put the jar of cookies in a big envelope. The postman said, "What a generous gift! Your friends will be very happy to receive these cookies in the mail."

As they walked back home, the granddaughter asked, "Grandma, can I have a pill for my headache?" The grandma replied, "Of course, dear. Let me get you some water to take the pill with." The granddaughter felt better and said, "Thank you, grandma. You're the best!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his blocks. He had a big pile of blocks that he would stack up and knock down. One day, Timmy received a new set of blocks from his grandma. He was so excited to play with them!

Timmy started building a tall tower with his new blocks. But then, his little sister came over and accidentally knocked it down. Timmy got very mad and threw his blocks all over the room. His mom came in and told him he couldn't play with his blocks anymore because he was being too rough.

Timmy was sad that he couldn't play with his blocks anymore. He realized that he should have been more careful and not let his anger take over. From then on, he tried to be more patient and gentle with his toys.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to draw with his pen. He drew a picture of a car with his pen. Then, he got tired and wanted to sit down.
Timmy's mom saw him and asked, "Are you tired, Timmy?"
Timmy said, "Yes, Mommy. I want to seat down."
His mom said, "Okay, let's find a seat for you."
They found a big chair and Timmy sat down. He looked at his picture and smiled. "I like my car," he said.
His mom smiled too and said, "You did a great job with your pen, Timmy. I'm proud of you."
Timmy felt happy and not tired anymore. He hugged his mom and said, "Thank you, Mommy."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved playing with his toy cars. One day, he went to the park to play with his friends. He brought his favorite car with him, a red one with big wheels.

When Timmy arrived at the park, he saw a new boy playing with his friends. The new boy had a toy car too, but it was different. It had big, black wheels and could go really fast. Timmy was curious and wanted to play with the new boy's car, but the new boy said no.

Timmy felt sad and didn't understand why the new boy wouldn't share his car. Timmy's friend, Sarah, explained to him that the new boy was ignorant and didn't know how to share. Timmy recognized that he didn't want to be like the new boy and decided to keep playing with his own car and sharing it with his friends.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. Jack was very restless and couldn't sit still for long. One day, Jack's mom took him to the toy store to buy him a new toy. Jack was very happy and excited.
At the store, Jack saw a toy car that he really liked. He asked his mom to buy it for him. But his mom said, "Jack, you already have so many toys. Maybe we should save our money for something else."

Jack was disappointed and started to cry. He didn't understand why he couldn't have the toy car. But then, a kind old man who was standing nearby said, "Hey there, young man. You don't need to score more toys to be happy. Sometimes, it's better to rest and appreciate what you already have."

Jack thought about what the old man said and realized that his mom was right. He didn't need more toys to be happy. He hugged his mom and said, "Thank you for taking me to the store, Mom. I'm happy with what I have."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a cat named Mittens. Mittens was a fluffy white cat with big blue eyes. Lily loved her cat very much.

One day, Lily and Mittens went to the store to buy some cat food. They saw a toy that Lily really wanted, but it was too expensive. Lily said to Mittens, "I wish I could have that toy, but it's too expensive."

Mittens meowed and then suddenly, something changed. The store owner came over and said, "I have a surprise for you, Lily. The toy is now on sale and it's not expensive anymore." Lily was so happy and hugged Mittens, "Thank you for changing my luck, Mittens!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big red case with her everywhere she went. One day, she went to the park to play. She saw her friend, Timmy, and ran over to him.
"Hi, Timmy! Want to play with me?" asked Lily.
"Sure, what do you want to play?" replied Timmy.
"I want to play house. You can be the dad and I'll be the mom," said Lily.
"Okay, I can do that. Where should we set up our house?" asked Timmy.
"Over there, by the big tree," said Lily, pointing to a spot.

So, they set up their house and played for hours. They were so busy having fun that they didn't even notice when it was time to go home. Lily picked up her red case and said goodbye to Timmy. She couldn't wait to come back and play again tomorrow.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved ponies and always wanted one. One day, her parents surprised her with a beautiful pony named Daisy. Lily was so happy and welcomed Daisy with open arms.

But one day, Lily woke up to a gloomy day. She didn't feel happy and didn't want to play with Daisy. Daisy was sad and didn't understand why Lily didn't want to play. Lily's mom noticed how sad Daisy was and asked Lily what was wrong. Lily told her mom that she was feeling sad and didn't want to play.

Her mom explained to Lily that sometimes we have bad days, but it's important to still be kind and welcoming to others. Lily realized that she had been ignoring Daisy and not being kind. She went outside and welcomed Daisy back with open arms. From that day on, Lily learned that even on gloomy days, it's important to be kind and welcoming to others.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside and get dirty. One day, her mother saw her and said, "Lily, you need to wash your hands before dinner."
Lily replied, "But Mama, I don't want to wash my hands. They are not dirty."
Her mother smiled and said, "I know, but it's important to wash our hands so we don't get sick. Plus, it's always good to be clean."

Lily thought about it for a moment and then said, "Okay, Mama. I will wash my hands." So, Lily went to the sink and washed her hands with soap and water until they were clean and shiny. Her mother smiled and said, "Good job, Lily. You're an original girl."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little bird who loved to sing. She lived in a big tree with many branches. One day, she met a big bird who told her she had a terrible voice. The little bird felt sad and stopped singing.

But then, she remembered something her mother told her. She said, "Listen to your heart and never give up on what you love." So, the little bird listened to her heart and started singing again. She sang louder and more beautifully than ever before.

The big bird heard her and was amazed. He said, "I was wrong. Your voice is not terrible, it's wonderful!" The little bird smiled and continued to sing, happy that she listened to her heart and didn't give up on her passion. The moral of the story is to always believe in yourself and never let anyone bring you down.
